data.title: 在原七海 · 耳机里的回音
data.description: 联络短暂中断后，七海停在走廊里检查耳机。听到信号重新接通，她才放下另一只手中的记录本。
data.action: checking her earpiece while holding a notebook
data.promptProse: In a dimly lit, modern building corridor, Nanami pauses to adjust her earpiece, holding a leather-bound notebook in her other hand as the communication signal flickers back to life. The overhead fluorescent lights cast crisp shadows against the sleek wall, emphasizing the quiet, tense anticipation of her mission.
